FILRODENSWMB.UI.ShortcutEscape: Escape to close a menu or dialogue
FILRODENSWMB.UI.ImportSettingsEmpty: That file didn't contain any recognised custom biomes or styles.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.LevelWatersHint: How far this layer's regions claim the sea from their coasts, in the map unit. Water goes to the nearest region, so neighbours meet halfway; a lake with one region on all its shores is wholly that region's. At 0 regions own land only. The waters follow every stroke.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.PinStyleHint: A named look for a kind of place: its icon, colour and size, and its label's size and visibility. A pin made with a style follows the style when it is edited. Pin styles are managed in Styles and icons.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.PinStyleLabelHint: What the label of a pin made with this style starts with. A label style sets its font, colour, width and alignment; the size here is used over the label style's own.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.RouteDetailEditorHint: Used by Simplify: a waypoint is dropped when it lies within this many map cells of the line between its neighbours. The same setting as Detail on the bar.
FILRODENSWMB.JOURNAL.StandardPalette: No custom biome colours applied. Standard palette active.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.HelpCreditsIntro: The module includes this code, these icons and these fonts, each under its own licence.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.FaultSpacingHint: The typical distance between volcanoes, in island sizes. Low values merge neighbouring volcanoes into larger islands.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.EngineStandardHint: Uses standard noise generation to create quick, randomised terrain.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.MapUnitHint: The name of the unit every distance on this map is shown in: the scale bar, territorial waters, the thematic layers and the line below. The module measures distances in kilometres and shows the number with this name, so the figures are true kilometres whatever the unit is called. Change it to give the unit your world's own name.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.MapUnitConverted: This map's scale bar used the old default unit, Miles, for distances the module measures in kilometres. Its map unit is now km (in New map, under Generation). Save the map to keep the change.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.ThematicCultureHint: The culture most of the people belong to in the last generator run, in its colour. The colour is paler where several peoples live together.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.ThematicTradeHint: The trade the last generator run carried, along its roads, rivers and sea lanes: the wider the line, the busier the route. It can be shown on its own or beside a colour layer.
